messages:
Zoe (Partnerships): starting a focused checklist thread for the marketplace offer: assets + IAM roles + pricing SKU shape + trial UX. goal: staging offer by next Wednesday. keeping this slim so review is quick.

Claire (Legal): quick heads-up 100: Azure has a checkbox about telemetry disclosures. i'll need the exact string of what we collect before i can sign off.

Dev (Product): summary: SKU family `redwood-inference` with plans `payg`, `monthly`, `reserved-commit`. trial: 14d with a 100k token cap, auto-expire unless upgraded. UX note: trial->paid modal should surface billing preview.

Markus (Cloud): infra side: AWS requires a cross-account publisher role and an AMI for private offers. GCP wants a service account with roles/cloudbilling.user + iam.serviceAccountUser for partner flows. Azure: publisher onboarding needs Offer ID and Plan IDs. i'll paste minimal AWS trust policy in the doc.

Pri (Design): assets: hero image 1200x400, logo (png + svg), 1024x1024 icon for marketplace. i'll provide two variants: conservative and splashy. also short descriptions: 1-line + 200-char + 4 bullet features.

Zoe (Partnerships): action items: Claire -> telemetry + DPA wording (Thu EOD); Dev -> final SKU table + billing preview copy (Tue); Markus -> IAM snippets + AMI/container tagging rules (Wed); Pri -> assets + localized short descs for DE/FR (Wed).

Claire (Legal): will also flag indemnity/insurance phrasing if marketplace requires additional vendor clauses. ping me if you want a redlined publisher agreement.

Markus (Cloud): ticket-bot created MKT-6107 for staging-tenant + CI tagging. ETA: 48h. linking in doc.

ticket-bot: created ticket MKT-6107 assigned to Markus (Cloud). ETA 2 business days.

Dev (Product): small question: should reserved-commit be a separate offer or a plan within the same listing? Ops/finance prefers separate SKU for billing clarity. any objections?

Zoe (Partnerships): finance has said separate SKU is cleaner for metering and quotas. go with separate SKU for reserved-commit. document that as decision.

Pri (Design): uploaded assets to https://intra.redwood/marketplace/assets/6107. left notes on accessibility and color palettes.

Markus (Cloud): i'll drop the IAM terraform snippets and an example `image_tags` CI job stanza. also adding a short runbook for publishing AMI + container.

Claire (Legal): once I have the telemetry list i'll return with localized EULA blurbs for DE/FR. remember to include data residency claims if customers want EU-only hosting.

Zoe (Partnerships): thanks all. i'm scheduling a 30-min sign-off on Wed 10am PT. if blockers appear, please flag in this thread with the ticket number. :calendar:
